quotes.text: Every claim that meets objective policy is approved instantly. Every edge case lands neatly in a manager's queue with the context already attached. Humans make value judgments, not clerical confirmations.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sums up the division of labour between AI and human approvers.

quotes.text: Broad or ambiguous phrasing. Reasonable expense, recent purchase is AI poison. The system can't read corporate mood. It needs mathematical definitions
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concrete guidance for writing deterministic AI approval instructions.

quotes.text: Each pass should demonstrate consistent cause and effect. If responses fluctuate, the issue is your prompt clarity, not the AI model.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Puts responsibility for inconsistent AI decisions on prompt design and testing.

quotes.text: Think of it as your safety valve. Everything predictable flows past automatically. Anything nuanced lands on a manager's desk.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why AI approval stages still need human escalation.

quotes.text: This visible endpoint reinforces trust. Users see decisions inside their own table views. No separate tracking spreadsheet, no phantom approvals.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A practical warning against over-engineering approval flows.

takeaways: Copilot Studio agent flows let an AI stage evaluate each request against precise, testable policy instructions before any human sees it, so only borderline or high-value cases reach managers.
Manual stages, manager lookup via the user connector and conditions such as amount thresholds turn a single approval into a multi-tier process, with every decision logged in Dataverse.
Document inputs let the AI cross-check receipts against claim data, and disciplined testing, naming conventions, versioning and status updates make the flow reliable and auditable.
hook: Approval chains stall because people are on vacation or miss emails, and classic Power Automate approvals become fragile once you add thresholds and specialist reviews. This episode is for Power Platform and Copilot Studio makers who want to build AI-driven multistage approvals in agent flows that decide routine cases instantly, escalate exceptions to humans and stay auditable.
